authenticated session is returned.

get.summary: Get NATS settings
get.description:
Returns the current NATS URL configuration. The password component of the
URL is always redacted in the response. Changes take effect after the
controller is restarted.

put.description:
Update the NATS server URL. The URL is encrypted at rest. Changes take
effect **after the controller is restarted** — the live NATS connection is
not replaced while the controller is running.

Send `"url": null` to clear the stored URL (NATS will be disabled after
the next restart).

get.summary: Get network settings
Get OAuth settings
get.description:
Returns the current MCP OAuth authorization-server configuration.
Values are read from `global_settings` and reflect what will take effect
on next restart. The `restart_required` field indicates whether the
in-memory (boot-time) state differs from the persisted values.

The response includes an `ETag` header. Pass this value as `If-Match` when
calling `PUT /api/v1/global-settings/oauth`.

ETag.description: Current global settings version for optimistic locking

put.description:
Update the MCP OAuth authorization-server configuration. All fields are
optional — omitted fields keep their current value. Changes are written to
`global_settings` and take effect after the controller is restarted.

Requires the `If-Match` header with the ETag from
`GET /api/v1/global-settings/oauth`.

409.description: ETag mismatch — stale global settings version

- `pki_addr`: empty string clears the value; non-empty must start with

AccessPresetResponse.description: An access preset definition with its role composition.

effective_renewal_window_hours.description:
Effective renewal window in hours.

In automatic mode this equals `min(14 days, lifetime_hours / 5)`.
When an override is set this equals `renewal_window_hours_override`.

renewal_window_hours_override.description:
Admin-configured renewal window override in hours.

`null` means automatic mode: the window is `min(14 days, lifetime / 5)`.

ApplyPresetRequest.description: Request to apply an access preset to a user.

preset.description: The access preset name to apply.

AssignHostsRequest.description: Assign one or more hosts to a software item, each with its own plugin info.

AuditLogResponse.description:
A single tenant-scoped semantic audit log entry, returned by
`GET /api/v1/audit-logs`.

action_kind.description: Action kind: `"stateful"` (has before/after snapshots) or `"event"` (no state change).

after_snapshot.description: State snapshot after the action (only present for `stateful` actions).

before_snapshot.description: State snapshot before the action (only present for `stateful` actions).

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation UUID linking related audit entries.

id.description: Unique identifier of this audit log entry.

registration_token_required.description: Whether OIDC registration requires a registration token.

AuthorizationServerMetadata.description:
OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414 §2) returned from
`/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`.

BatchActionFailure.description: A failed item in a batch action.

error.description: Human-readable error message describing why the action failed.

id.description: The UUID of the entity that failed.

BatchActionRequest.description:
Request body for batch action endpoints.

Each resource's batch endpoint (`POST /api/v1/{resource}/batch`) accepts
this payload. The `action` string selects the operation (e.g. `"feature"`,
`"unfeature"`, `"delete"`) and `ids` lists the target entity UUIDs.

ids.description: The UUIDs of the entities to act upon.

BatchActionResponse.description:
Response body for batch action endpoints.

Reports per-item results, allowing partial success. Callers should inspect
both `succeeded` and `failed` to determine the outcome of each item.

failed.description: Items that failed, with per-item error messages.

BatchActionSuccess.description: A successfully processed item in a batch action.

id.description: The UUID of the successfully processed entity.

BatchSkippedItem.description: An item that was skipped during batch creation.

BatchUpdateItem.description: A single item within a batch update response.

batch_id.description: Batch ID, if a batch was created (omitted when `total_created` is 0).

skipped.description: Items that were skipped (existing active update, missing plugin, etc.).

oneOf.description: Details when the coordinator is in a degraded state.
Summary of the last successfully applied reload cycle.

recent_events.description: Recent reload lifecycle events (up to 20, newest last).

sections.description: Redacted snapshot of the active config sections (secrets shown as `"<redacted>"`).

CreateDiscoveryAllowlistEntryRequest.description: Request body for creating a tenant-wide or host-specific discovery allowlist entry.

plugin_type.description:
Plugin type to allow for discovery.

Must be a known plugin type that has the `DiscoverLocalSoftware` capability.
`Other`/unknown plugin types are rejected.

CreateEnrollmentTokenRequest.description: Request to create a new enrollment token.

allowed_capabilities.description:
Restrict the token to services with at least one of these capabilities.
`None` means wildcard (any service type).

expires_in_seconds.description: Token lifetime in seconds from now. `None` means never expires.

max_uses.description:
Maximum number of enrollments allowed with this token.
`None` means unlimited.

CreateHostTagRequest.description: Request to create a new host tag.

enabled.description: Whether the config is enabled. Defaults to true.

CreateSoftwareIgnoreRequest.description: Request body for creating a software ignore rule.

host_id.description:
Optionally scope the ignore rule to a specific host.
`None` means the rule applies tenant-wide.

name.description: Software item display name to permanently suppress from future discoveries.

CreateSoftwareItemRequest.description: Create a new software item (catalog entry only — no plugin coupling).

featured.description: Whether this item is featured (shown prominently). Defaults to true for manual creation.

icon_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to an icon/logo image for this software item.

CreateSystemEnrollmentTokenRequest.description:
Request to create a new system enrollment token.

System enrollment tokens are globally scoped (no tenant) and are used
to auto-approve system service enrollments (MQTT bridge, external scheduler).

expires_in_seconds.description: Token lifetime in seconds from now. `None` means never expires.

max_uses.description:
Maximum number of system service enrollments allowed with this token.
`None` means unlimited.

DegradedInfoView.description: View of the coordinator's degraded state.

failed_subsystems.description: Names of the subsystems that failed to revert.

reason.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

since.description: When the coordinator entered the degraded state.

client_id.description: Public client identifier. Must match the server's configured constant.

client_name.description: Uptrakit extension: free-form audit label, e.g. `cli-laptop-2026-05-12`.

scope.description:
Optional space-separated scope list (RFC 6749 §3.3). Stored on the flow
row, echoed on the token response, not yet enforced.

EnrollmentTokenCreatedResponse.description:
Response returned when a new enrollment token is created.
The plaintext `token` is only available in this response.

token.description: The plaintext token value. Only returned once at creation time.

EnrollmentTokenResponse.description: Response for an enrollment token (without the plaintext token).

EnrollmentTokensSummary.description: Summary of enrollment tokens for the combined settings response.

active_count.description: Number of active (non-revoked, non-expired, uses remaining) tokens.

ErrorResponse.description:
Standard error response returned by all API endpoints.

All error responses from the API are JSON objects with an `error` field
containing a human-readable message, and an optional `code` field for
machine-readable error classification.

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code for programmatic handling.

loaded_at.description: When the file was last successfully loaded.

path.description: Absolute path to the TOML config file.

pending_detected_at.description: When the pending change was first detected.

pending_digest.description:
`sha256:<hex>` of a detected-but-unapplied change; `null` when no change
is pending or the changed file could not be read.

api_base_url.description: Custom API base URL override for GitHub Enterprise.

auth_token.description: Masked token sentinel (`***`) when a token exists.

has_auth_token.description: Whether an auth token is currently configured.

GlobalSettingsCombinedResponse.description: Combined response for all global (infrastructure-scoped) settings.

HostBatchUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/hosts/{host_id}/batch-update`.

Triggers updates for all outdated software items on the given host, with
optional filtering by update category.

category_filter.description:
Only include items with this update category (e.g. `"security"`).
`None` means all outdated items.

exclude_item_ids.description: Exclude specific software items from the batch.

host_id.description: Host UUID this entry applies to.

HostPluginRoleAssignment.description: A plugin assignment for a specific role on a host-software pair.

oneOf.description: Plugin-specific overrides merged onto the base config at resolution time.

execution_site.description:
Controls where this plugin's operation is executed.
- `"auto"`: system decides based on plugin capabilities (default)
- `"agent"`: always run on the agent
- `"controller"`: always run on the controller (only valid for `fetch_releases`)

ordinal.description: Ordinal for hook roles; must be `0` for non-hook roles. Defaults to `0`.

oneOf.description: Inline plugin config to create (mutually exclusive with `plugin_config_id`).

plugin_config_id.description: UUID of an existing plugin config to use.

HostPluginRoleSummary.description:
Summary of a plugin role assignment on a host-software pair (read-only).

When the assignment was created via autodiscovery (package managers),
`plugin_config_id` and `plugin_config_name` are `None` — the plugin type
is read directly from the HSIP row's `plugin_type` column.

ordinal.description: Ordinal (0-based) for hook roles; always 0 for non-hook roles.

plugin_config_id.description: `None` for autodiscovered package-manager assignments (no stored config).

features.description: Agent-reported host features. Empty if not reported (legacy agent).

software_status.description: Aggregate software status for host-list rendering.

HostSoftwareAssignment.description:
Per-host plugin assignment used when assigning hosts to a software item.

Each host assignment contains a list of role-specific plugin assignments.
At minimum, a `detect_version` role should be provided for version tracking.

plugins.description: Role-specific plugin assignments for this host-software pair.

HostTagResponse.description: Full host tag response with host count.

HostTagSummary.description: Slim tag summary for embedding in host responses.

InstancePluginDetail.description:
Detailed view (currently identical to summary; reserved for future fields
such as last-toggled-by, audit trail, etc.).

InstancePluginSummary.description:
One row in the Instance Plugins admin section. Returned only to users
holding `ManageGlobalSettings`.

ItemBatchUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/v1/software-items/{id}/batch-update`.

Rolls out a software item to all (or selected) assigned hosts.

host_ids.description: Limit the rollout to specific hosts. `None` means all assigned hosts.

LastReloadView.description: Summary of the last successfully applied reload cycle.

sections.description: Config sections that changed during this reload.

oneOf.description:
The refresh token to revoke. Optional when the token is provided
via the `refresh_token` `HttpOnly` cookie.

MaskedUrl.description:
A URL that may contain embedded credentials.

`Display`, `Debug`, and `Serialize` always emit the password portion
replaced with `***` so that the value is safe to log and return in API
responses. The raw URL is accessible via [`as_raw_str`](Self::as_raw_str)
for internal use (connecting, encrypting, storing).

The inner `String` is zeroed (overwritten with zeros) when the value is
dropped, preventing credentials from lingering in freed heap memory.

# Design note

This is a closed, centralized enum rather than a trait-based capability system.
All plugins in this project are first-party and registered exclusively through
`uptrakit-plugin-registry` (see AGENTS.md: "adding a new plugin only through
the registry is an acceptable tradeoff"). `#[non_exhaustive]` allows adding new
variants in future releases without requiring downstream match-arm updates.

SecretString.description:
A newtype wrapper for strings that contain sensitive data (secrets, tokens,
passwords).

# Security properties

- **`Debug`** and **`Display`** implementations redact the value, preventing
  accidental exposure in logs, error chains, and tracing output.
- **`ZeroizeOnDrop`** overwrites the backing heap allocation with zeros when
  the value is dropped.
- **`Serialize`** is **transparent** (`#[serde(transparent)]`): serializing a
  `SecretString` emits the plaintext value. Never serialize structs containing
  `SecretString` to logs or debug output — use `Debug` formatting instead.
- **`Clone`** creates a new heap allocation containing the secret. Each clone
  must be properly dropped (not leaked or stored in a non-zeroizing container)
  to ensure the zeroize guarantee is upheld.
- **`PartialEq`** uses the standard `String` comparison, which short-circuits
  on the first mismatched byte. Do not use `PartialEq` for authentication
  comparisons where timing side channels are a concern; use a constant-time
  comparison function instead (e.g., `subtle::ConstantTimeEq` or
  `argon2::password_hash::PasswordVerifier`).
